title: DentIndices: open, tested oral-health epidemiology indices
description: DentIndices computes the indices used in oral-health surveys, trials and clinics: DMFT/DMFS and dmft/dmfs with WHO 2013 coding, the Significant Caries Index (SiC), the Specific affected Caries Index (SaC), care and restorative indices, PUFA/pufa, the Basic Periodontal Examination (BPE) and the simplified BPE for under-18s, CPITN, the WHO 2013 modified CPI and loss of attachment, the Silness–Löe Plaque Index, the Löe–Silness Gingival Index, O'Leary's Plaque Control Record, OHI-S, the Basic Erosive Wear Examination (BEWE), Dean's fluorosis index and the Community Fluorosis Index, the Dental Aesthetic Index (DAI), and the CDC/AAP and ACES (2018 classification for epidemiological surveys) periodontitis case definitions, with population summaries (mean, CI, prevalence with Wilson CI, SiC, SaC). Every code table, threshold and interpretation band is kept in one machine-readable registry next to the publication it comes from, with a verification level (primary or secondary) and a documented decision wherever sources are silent or disagree. Every result returns its components, interpretation band, the source's guidance, data warnings, a step-by-step trace and the references to cite. It ships as a dependency-free Python package and command-line tool (pip install dentindices) and as a private in-browser application whose JavaScript engine is tested for identical output against the Python package. Research, teaching and survey tool; it computes indices from recorded findings and does not diagnose.
